$comment: UVT/core 1.0 conformance vectors. The accept cases are the shipped fixtures; the reject cases are mutations of them, expressed in the same four-operation vocabulary the other suites use, so a second implementation executes them rather than reading them.
note: Plan item 17 required the schema, the fixtures and the validator before the operation, and this suite is that gate. Block 12 slice 12-1 added the first materializer (uncompressed 8-bit RGBA, one level) on the other side of it; these vectors still test the profile rules, never a particular converter.

vectors.note: the plain case: one 2D sRGB image, straight alpha, one level, no mip filtering
a square cubemap with a full mip chain and zstd supercompression
an array with premultiplied alpha, a swizzle and three atlas regions
a cubemap whose faces are not square is refused rather than stretched
levelCount 0 is a loader instruction, not a description of the file
a premultiplied alpha mode over a container flag that is clear is a contradiction, and it changes every pixel it touches
the mirror rule: an opaque projection cannot sit over a premultiplied container
asking for mip filtering on a single-level texture is a request the file cannot satisfy
a region running off the edge is refused rather than clamped: clamping produces a different sprite
two regions cannot share an id: an atlas is addressed by name
